title: Median of Grouped Data — Statistics
hook: Let's explore Median of Grouped Data from the chapter on Statistics. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Median of Grouped Data Median = l + [(n/2 − cf)/f] × h, where l = lower limit of median class, cf = cumulative frequency before median class, f = frequency of median class. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Find n/2, then locate the median class using cumulative frequency
💡 Median = l + [(n/2 − cf)/f] × h
💡 l = lower boundary of median class, h = class width
💡 cf = cumulative frequency of class BEFORE the median class
